run_evaluation_checkpoint: run an alphastar evaluation on an existing checkpoint for one full episode against a bot
run_evaluation_random_params: run an alphastar evaluator with random parameters for a few steps to verify it works
run_evaluation_latest_checkpoint: run an alphastar evaluation on the most recent checkpoint in a directory during parallel training
review_main: review the main function that sets up an architecture and runs an evaluation episode with EvalActor
summarize_eval_actor: summarize how EvalActor is configured with architecture, episode logger, and converter settings for evaluation
